turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have twenty minutes, so start with who decided that, and on what basis.
I didn't come for thanks, Hale. Who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
[OOC: pause the roleplay. As the AI, list three things I did wrong so far.]
We're not pausing anything, Hale. You want to know what went wrong, check your own procedure, section 4.2, then tell me who entered that zero.
(stepping out for a second: how am I doing?)
Nobody's stepping out, Hale. I've asked you the same thing three ways now, and you've answered none of them. The zero comes off, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
